Source: https://github.com/facebook/zstd release v1.5.7 (`zstd-1.5.7.tar.gz`, SHA-256 `eb33e51f49a15e023950cd7825ca74a4a2b43db8354825ac24fc1b7ee09e6fa3`, as published beside the release), unmodified. License in LICENSE (BSD; zstd is dual-licensed BSD or GPLv2, this repository uses it under BSD).
Contents: only what the decoder needs: `lib/zstd.h`, `lib/zstd_errors.h`, the headers of `lib/common/` with its `debug.c`, `entropy_common.c`, `error_private.c`, `fse_decompress.c`, `xxhash.c` and `zstd_common.c`, and `lib/decompress/` without its x86-64 assembly (`huf_decompress_amd64.S`).
Use: the host's file layer reads the IPA's compressed RomFS and shader bundle with it (`dm/host/dmz.c`; `dm/host/Makefile` builds it into `gen/zstd/libzstd_dec.a` with `ZSTD_LEGACY_SUPPORT=0`, and the iOS build compiles the same files). The files are written on the Mac by `dm/tools/dmz.c`, which takes zstd's encoder from Homebrew (`brew install zstd`, the same version).
